correctness.rationale: For the full domain n>=3, the corona adjacency eigenvalues split into two disjoint simple fibre branches for each base eigenspace. Exact Schur-square calculation gives the tensor-sector identity R tensor P+ plus S tensor P-. Fourier projectors of C_n give every eigenvalue of both sectors, and zero weights occur at a nontrivial even frequency precisely when 4 divides n. R has rank n for odd n and n/2 for even n; S has ranks n, n/2, n/2-1 in the three cases. Finite rational frequency and independent matrix checks corroborate the unrestricted proof; they are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sunlet graphs naturally measure the impact of attaching identical local pendant quantum sites to a cycle. An exact spectrum and sharp all-order rank classification distinguish ordinary antipodal rank collapse from a singular zero-energy contribution; the n-1 rank at multiples of four is not an arbitrary parameter slice and identifies a precise physical-mathematical resonance. The formula gives the kernel sectors and supports future analysis of pendant modifications, without assuming a downstream theorem.
